title: feat(tui): defer long-run charm 1s clock until DELAY_MS
claim: useLongRunToolCharms should arm zero 1 s timers before any tool is DELAY_MS (8 s) old and exactly one after, without changing when charms fire.

evidence.source: main ui-tui/src/app/useLongRunToolCharms.ts:23-67: effect on [tools] calls tick() and setInterval(tick, 1000) whenever busy && tools.length; tick skips tools younger than DELAY_MS=8000. Hook holds no React state: ticks never render. Unchanged since fork merge-base.
evidence.measured: Real hook under vi fake timers (1 s callbacks counted via setInterval wrapper, charms via turnController.pushActivity spy): 20 s tool - main 7 no-op 1 s callbacks before eligibility (+1 immediate tick), rebuild 0; charms [8000, 18000] ms on both. 5 s tool - main 5 callbacks, rebuild 0, charms 0 on both. Renders/commits/frames saved: 0 (the ticks are no-op loops; no setState). During busy turns the status rule already repaints at >=1 Hz (FaceTicker 1 s clock + glyph timer), so the saving is one no-op timer callback per second (a loop over live tools; per-call CPU not separately measured) with no render, frame or user-visible effect.
evidence.red: longRunCharmClock.test.tsx test 1 on main: 'AssertionError: expected [ 1000, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000, …(2) ] to deeply equal []'.
evidence.fork_head_reproof: Exact fork-head hook (689436079a) on main: test 2 FAILS 'expected [] to have a length of 2 but got +0'. Fork re-checks longRunCharmArmPlan at timeout fire and returns without arming when still 'deferred'; a wake 1 ms before Date.now() reaches startedAt+DELAY_MS therefore drops every charm for that tools array. Real Node 26.7 probe: 4/20 setTimeout(50) callbacks observed Date.now() delta 49 ms (early by 1 ms) -> fork head is NEEDS-REWORK on its own terms.
evidence.green: Rebuild (one setTimeout to the first eligibility, then the unchanged tick + 1 s interval; tick re-checks ages so an early wake just costs one tick): 2/2 pass, 3x shuffled green.
evidence.negative_control: NC1 no deferral (start immediately) -> test 1 fails (7 pre-eligibility ticks); NC2 fork-style re-check-and-bail in start() -> test 2 fails (0 charms).
evidence.adjacent: moaProgressActivity, thinkingLiveCollapse, appChromeBlockedTimers + new file: 4 files/37 tests pass; turnControllerNotice, turnControllerTodos, turnStore: 3 files/9 tests pass. typecheck clean; eslint + prettier clean. NOT_TESTED: live TUI.
